title: AC1027 LIGHTLIST physical inline handle role and graph output blocker

source.method: Locally authored from scratch with ezdxf 1.4.5 and tools/lightlist_physical_graph_probe.py, then ODA File Converter 27.1.0 DXF to ACAD2013 DWG to DXF. No drawing fixture was added. Generated file hashes bind this exact run; newly authored file identifiers may differ.

dxfGraph: ODA DXF readback retains NOD ACAD_LIGHT -> dictionary 0x30 -> LIGHTLIST 0xF000, LIGHTLIST owner and ACAD_REACTORS dictionary pointer 0x30, and entry handle 0x2F with name LOCAL_LIGHT. A LIGHT entity with handle 0x2F and name LOCAL_LIGHT is present. Autodesk LIGHTLIST DXF reference describes these groups: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2015/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-C4E7FFF8-C3ED-43DD-854D-304F87FFCF06.htm . ODA output is one producer observation, not independent native lighting semantics.
dwgEvidence: LibreDWG 0.14 trace identifies a 40-byte custom LIGHTLIST body with 33 handle bits and handle-stream boundary bit 287. Its split-string flag is set and its 186-bit string payload plus 17-bit footer begins at bit 84. Version and count BL fields end at bits 58 and 68. In the libdxfrw-extracted raw frame, witness-specific bit walk [68,84) is 0x012F: role nibble 0, length 1, value 0x2F; common owner and reactor at [287,303) and [303,319) are both 0x4130 (role 4, length 1, value 0x30). A native typed callback reports handle 0x2F and name LOCAL_LIGHT, but its parser does not enforce the role. This is an in-tree raw-frame extraction and separate bit walk, not an independent decompressor or semantic oracle.
peerLimit: LibreDWG identifies the LIGHTLIST and LIGHT, but its LIGHTLIST handle decoder overreads the detached handle stream and reports a null entry while retaining the name. It therefore does not independently validate the type-specific reference value or role. ODA v5.4.1 has no LIGHTLIST-specific DWG record section, and its handle relation table specifies codes 2,3,4,5 but does not establish the relationship represented by this role-0 occurrence. Existing generated libdxfrw writer emits role 5 for this field; source role 0 cannot be assumed equivalent.
behavior: No parser, graph or output admission was broadened. The adapter continues to refuse retained LIGHTLIST. Whole-source strict completeness, proxy-preview preservation and native lighting behavior remain unqualified.
reproduce: <scratch>/probe <scratch>/dwg/scene.dwg; bind any exact-span observation to source SHA-256 before and after the probe.
next: Find an independent, correctly decoding LIGHTLIST DWG implementation or obtain authoritative LIGHTLIST role semantics; construct a nonempty producer witness with multiple distinct handles and prove exact role, identity, owner, reciprocal graph and independent native/readback semantics before output admission.
